ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1
Neighborhood Shopping District, B1-2 Neighborhood Shopping District, and RS-3
Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District, symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 20-F in the area bound by:

A line 231.5 feet north of and parallel to West 80th Street; South Emerald
Avenue; West 80th Street; the public alley next west and parallel to South
Emerald Avenue; a line 122.5 feet north of and parallel to West 80th Street;
and South Halsted Street,

to those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, relief
pursuant to Section 17-13-1101-M of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance is included.

SECTION 3. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
